notes: Tripled-length re-run of 021 (400000 -> 1200000 steps), identical config otherwise: DQfD with 100000 demo transitions + higher epsilon floor (0.15) + LoopBreakerWrapper active during training itself. Run 021 sustained 22-39% eval win rate across its whole 400k steps with win-rate improvement clearly decelerating but not flat (quarterly means 24.3% -> 28.5% -> 30.1% -> 30.8%, regression slope ~2.0 pts/100k steps overall vs ~1.2 pts/100k in the back half) while loss was STILL declining steeply with no sign of flattening (57.5 -> 21.3 -> 8.7 -> 3.6 across quarters) - real optimization headroom left, testing whether win rate keeps climbing (even if slowly) over a much longer hold at the epsilon floor, or genuinely plateaus somewhere in this extended run. Otherwise our cleanest baseline: Double DQN, soft target updates, n-step=3, PER, raw card encoding, hidden-layers=2, undo allowed, 1000-step episode ceiling, cold start.
